title: Getting to Bondi Beach: Transport & Parking
metaDescription: How to get to Bondi Beach — from Sydney Airport and the CBD by train, bus, taxi and car, plus where to park and how far Bondi is from key spots.
intro: There's no train to Bondi Beach itself — the trick most visitors miss. Here's how to get here from the airport or the city, and where to actually put the car if you drive.
